اعتذرتم (form VIII)
# اِعْتَذَرْتُمْ (iʕtaḏartum) /iʕ.ta.ðar.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
# اُعْتُذِرْتُمْ (uʕtuḏirtum) /uʕ.tu.ðir.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
